blurb:
Unwind with the Sacred Stone Sound Bath, an exclusive crystal sound healing experience in Minneapolis. Each session pairs you with a unique crystal companion, enhancing your personal journey. 

Guided intention-setting prepares your mind for relaxation, while soothing sound bowls and chimes fill the air, allowing you to immerse yourself in tranquility. 

This is a 60-minute session, limited to just four guests for personalized attention. No prior experience is necessary—simply arrive with an open heart and a desire to recharge.
